### Blessings for Esau
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/blessings-esau
Passage: Genesis 36:7b-8
Points:
- Moses regularly details the family line of the non-covenant son right before focusing on the covenant heirs.
- God faithfully fulfilled His promise to Isaac by making faithless Esau into a prosperous and populous nation.
- Esau's temporal blessings show that God often grants earthly success even to those who reject spiritual realities.
- Earthly and material prosperity is never by itself proof of authentic faith or salvation.
- Believers are challenged to examine their hearts and pursue God's kingdom rather than merely enjoying temporal gifts.
